text: Teaching Objectives The joint MBA Program between Ningbo University( MBU) and the University of Canberra( UC) was started in 2001 upon the approval of the Ministry of Education of China. It is the only Chinese-foreign joint MBA program in Zhejiang Province, China. Up to now, more than 369 advanced managerial professionals have graduated from this program. The program is now positively recognized in China and abroad Main Courses Financial Management Marketing Economics and Policy Entrepreneurship Business Finance International Trade Law BGL Research Project Fee RMB 100,000 of tuition and RMB 3,000 of textbook fee for 2 years totally Duration 2 years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted MBA by UC Extra Service Students are encouraged to attend Chinese language courses at NBU for free when studying MBA courses
